'''Vladimir Andreyevich Markov''' ({{langx|ru|Влади́мир Андре́евич Ма́рков}}; May 8, 1871 &ndash; January 18, 1897) was a Russian [[mathematician]], known for proving the [[Markov brothers' inequality]] with his older brother [[Andrey Markov]]. He died of tuberculosis at the age of 25.<ref>{{cite journal|script-title=ru:В Комиссии по истории физико-математических наук. Заседание памяти Владимира Андреевича Маркова|language=Russian|journal=УМН|volume=9|issue=4(62)|year=1954|pages=256&ndash;258|url=http://mi.mathnet.ru/umn8137}}</ref>
